description: Defines classes and functions for managing CPU affinity masks and thread pinning policies within the 'ocudu' namespace, including round-robin and mask-based policies.

classes.name: os_sched_affinity_manager
classes.description: Manages CPU affinity masks for threads based on configured policies, supporting round-robin and mask sharing strategies.
